record.body:
## Correction

`<failure>` stays `assertion_failed`, including a test-body `ModuleNotFoundError`. Do not read the failure message and do not remap those cases to `errored`.

`test_verdict_refuses_not_assertion` must be a collection error, which pytest records as `<error>`. A module-level import of a missing module in the base oracle is that case. A test-body import is an assertion red under `assertion-signal`.

Remove `_NON_ASSERTION`, the JUnit re-parse, and the `tempfile.mkstemp` hook. Do not import `affidavit.runner._keys`. Silencing the child process stdio can stay so the CLI prints only verdict JSON.
